text_original: Collector paraphrase (not verbatim source text): Reviewer lists the Model S Plaid at 1,006 hp and 0-100 km/h in 2.1 s against 590 hp and 0-60 mph in 3.7 s for the BMW i5 M60. Reviewer cites 348-390 miles of range for the Plaid against about 265 miles (EPA) for the i5 M60, although the test cycles differ. Reviewer's verdict ranks the Model S Plaid second, ahead of the BMW i5 M60 in third, while praising the i5's refinement and rounded abilities; the Mercedes-AMG EQE 53 won.
